# Morris & Dewett Injury Lawyers

> > Morris & Dewett is a personal injury law firm serving Ruston, Louisiana, specializing in construction accidents, wrongful death claims, traffic accidents, and product liability cases.

Morris & Dewett Injury Lawyers provides comprehensive legal representation for injury victims in Ruston and throughout Louisiana. The firm handles complex personal injury cases including construction site accidents, wrongful death claims, and negligence matters, with expertise in workplace safety regulations and accident compensation.
